run_training_cli: run the fairseq training CLI to train a new model on one or multiple GPUs
run_main_training_loop: run the main training loop that orchestrates task setup, model building, and epoch iteration
run_train_epoch: run training for one epoch with progress logging and periodic validation
run_validate_model: run validation on specified subsets and return validation losses for checkpointing
run_early_stopping_check: run the early stopping check to determine if training should halt based on patience
